evidence.title: Authentication with API keys
evidence.quote: API keys use HTTP Basic client side authentication. Basic authentication is a simple authentication scheme built into the HTTP protocol. To use it, send your HTTP requests with an Authorization header that contains the word Basic followed by a space and a base64-encoded string composed of an api key followed by a colon. The API key acts as the username and the password is always empty.
